
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/iLoveMyD/p/20098840" title="发布于 2026-05-20 20:13">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Windows端安装perry.ts</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>2026年5月20日</p>
<p>看大家宣传的还不错, 装起来试试看</p>
<p>1. 官网&nbsp;<a href="https://perryts.com/zh-Hans#installation" rel="noopener nofollow">Perry — TypeScript → Native</a></p>
<p>2. 管理员打开终端(win11, 右键开始按钮, 选择终端管理员</p>
<p>3. 执行安装命令</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>winget <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> PerryTS.Perry</pre>
</div>
<p>4. 安装过程中, 会一起安装 LLVM, xwin, 你也可以通过其他网站下载后安装,</p>
<p>然后重新执行上边的命令, 如果已经检测到安装过了, 会跳过的,</p>
<p>所以安装时记得允许把可执行文件添加到环境变量中</p>
<p>虽然是从github安装, 但是没有FQ也可以下载安装, 软件很大, 记得要有管理员权限</p>
<p>如果下载成功安装失败, 可以查一下winget命令下载的软件在哪里, 然后找到双击安装</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Windows Toolchain Setup

  This downloads the Microsoft CRT </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Windows SDK libraries (via xwin)
  so Perry can link Windows executables without Visual Studio Build Tools.

  ✓ LLVM found: clang
  ✓ xwin found: C:\Users\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95486</span>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\PerryTS.Perry_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\xwin.exe</pre>
</div>
<p>5. 这俩软件安装完毕后执行初始化命令</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>perry setup windows</pre>
</div>
<p>这一步同样会检查之前的两个软件是否已经正常安装, 然后安装一些sdk类的东西</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">⚠ Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools License

  The Microsoft CRT </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Windows SDK libraries are redistributable under
  the Microsoft Software License Terms. By proceeding you accept:

    https:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=2086102</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Do you accept the license</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> yes

  Output: C:\Users\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95486</span>\AppData\Local\perry\windows-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sdk
  Expect </span>~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">700</span> MB download / ~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.5</span> GB unpacked.   CRT.libs.x86_64.store [0s] ███████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89.74</span> MiB/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">89.74</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MiB 📦 splatted

  SDK.headers.x86_64.none [0s] ███████████████████████████████████████████████████████ </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">163.65</span> KiB/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">163.65</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> KiB 📦 splatted

  ✓ Windows SDK ready at C:\Users\</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">95486</span>\AppData\Local\perry\windows-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sdk

  Try it:  perry compile hello.ts </span>&amp;&amp; ./hello.exe</pre>
</div>
<p>6. 以上安装结束后就可以试试了, 命令行进入到代码目录, 执行编译链接命令</p>
<p>测试代码文档:&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.perryts.com/" rel="noopener nofollow">Introduction - Perry Documentation</a></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>PS D:\code\perryproject&gt; perry compile hello.ts -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o hello.exe
Collecting modules...
Found </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> module(s): <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> native, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JavaScript
Generating code...
Wrote </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: hello_ts.o
Linking (runtime</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">only)...
Wrote executable: hello.exe
Binary size: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.2MB</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>7. 编译后代码目录文件</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/335252/202605/335252-20260520200937946-2092072718.png" alt="局部截取_20260520_200933" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;8. 命令行启动程序(没有界面, 所以是命令行直接输出)</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>PS D:\code\perryproject&gt; ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">hello.exe
Hello, Perry</span>!</pre>
</div>
<p>9. 搞个界面的</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/335252/202605/335252-20260520201607126-1147862178.png" alt="局部截取_20260520_201603" loading="lazy"></p>
